cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Tell Me I Did Enough
cards.instruction: Get someone to reassure you that your effort, choice, or survival was enough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've ticked my painting on the list like yours. One complete contribution. Tell me that's enough for our exhibition.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The ticks mean insured. I can spread my paintings out so nobody sees a gap.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, safely covered. I want to know my painting contributes, not that you can hide how little I finished.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Put yours in the middle. It's the first one people should see.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then introduce me as the other painter. I'd like to hear it without an apology for only bringing one.
